=== effective paths and ports ===
Paths:
  rx   PATH                  /commands
  r    config                /configuration/first-long-reference-directory /somewhere-else/second-l…
  rxw  config + temporary    /reference
  rxw  temporary             /output

Forwarded:
  3000 → http://127.9.9.9:3000
  3001 → http://127.9.9.9:3001

  r    drops                 /drops

  r    runtime               /runtime

  r    system                /etc/one

  rxw  tmp + sockets         /tmp

Paths:
  rx   PATH                  /path/{one,two}
  r    modules               /modules/cache
  r    runtime               /runtime/process
  rw   runtime               /runtime/ptys
  r    skills                /skills/{one,two}

=== read-only workspace ===
Paths:
  r    workspace             /workspace
=== writable workspace and denied names ===
Paths:
  rw   workspace             /workspace

Denied:
  secrets.yml, expenses.yml, domains.yml, auth.json, creds.json, .env, .env.prod, production
=== yolo ===
Paths:
  rxw  workspace             /workspace
  rxw  yolo shell            /

Forwarded:

No grants or forwarded ports.
